feeds.title: Atlanta Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: Read blog posts about our latest news and the animals who are currently or have recently been in our care. For more than 149 years, we have remained steadfast in our mission to stand strong in defense of the vulnerable. The Atlanta Humane Society aims to better lives, instill compassion, and uplift our whole community by connecting homeless animals with good homes and providing neglected animals with safe spaces.

feeds.title: HSSV Blog
feeds.description: Our blog features the latest stories and articles for and about animal lovers from Humane Society Silicon Valley (HSSV). Sign up for updates! Humane Society Silicon Valley (HSSV) is the world's first model shelter, accomplished by meeting the guidelines put forth by the Association of Shelter Veterinarians.

feeds.title: Spokane Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: We are a private, non-profit serving the public by providing care, shelter, and placement into loving homes for neglected and unwanted animals in the greater Spokane area through pet adoptions. Explore our blog for more information on pets available for adoption, tips for fostering and adopting your pet and more!

feeds.title: Winnipeg Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: Just 21 years after Winnipeg was incorporated as a city, The WHS was founded by a group of citizens concerned with the social welfare of the city, including musician and prominent society woman Jean Forsyth. Receive communication about pet adoptions, eNews, and volunteer opportunities.

feeds.title: Humane Society Naples Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date on all things HSN with our blog. Humane Society Naples believes everyone should have the opportunity to experience animal companionship. To make sure no one in our community lacks access to resources, HSN is committed to creating and maintaining a diverse, inclusive, and culturally compassionate team that advocates for animals and people in all areas of our community.

feeds.title: Jacksonville Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: The Jacksonville Humane Society provides care, comfort and compassion to animals in need while engaging the hearts, hands and minds of our community to bring about an end to the killing of abandoned and orphaned shelter animals. Stay up-to-date with animal shelter news and information from the Jacksonville Humane Society in Jacksonville, FL.

feeds.title: Ontario SPCA and Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: The Ontario SPCA's mission is to facilitate and provide for province-wide leadership on matters relating to the prevention of cruelty to animals and the promotion of animal welfare. The Society is working to bring an end to pet overpopulation and the abuse, neglect and abandonment of animals and promote respect and appreciation of animals. Read the latest news from Ontario SPCA.

feeds.title: Grand Strand Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: Grand Strand Humane Society exists to improve the quality of life to the lost, abandoned, helpless and homeless animals in the Myrtle Beach community by providing shelter, care and love. Because of our efforts we are proud to be a part of the No-Kill SC community. Get the latest news and updates from us along with tips and advice for strays and lost animals' welfare.

feeds.title: Nevada Humane Society
feeds.description: With Shelters located in Reno, and Carson City, the Nevada Humane Society Caring is a charitable, non-profit organization that accepts all pets, finds them homes, saves their lives, and is recognized as a leader in animal sheltering and stewardship. This blog is intended to showcase the amazing work our organization does everyday, the Happy Tails of the more than 16,000 pets in need we help each year and to promote the humane and loving treatment of our furry friends!

feeds.title: Oregon Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: News, blog posts and other stories from the Oregon Humane Society. Find news releases, event updates, and go behind the scenes at OHS via our blog. OHS is the largest animal welfare organization in the Northwest and adopts more animals from its Portland shelter than any other single-facility shelter on the West Coast.

feeds.title: KHS Blog
feeds.description: The Kentucky Humane Society (KHS) is a private, nonprofit organization that is Kentucky's largest pet adoption agency. KHS is also the state's oldest animal welfare organization, founded in 1884. Get the latest news from society, advice and resources to help keep your pet in your home and out of shelters.

feeds.title: Humane Society of West Michigan Blog
feeds.description: My name is Bunny and I am a permanent resident of Humane Society of West Michigan! I have been a beloved pet here for over 10 years. Thanks for coming to my blog to read about me and some of my friends at HSWM! I hope you enjoy learning a little bit about what we do here, and why it makes a difference.

feeds.title: Berkeley Humane Blog
feeds.description: Your resource for news, advice, and everything pets! The Berkeley Humane Blog is here for the animal-loving community. Berkeley Humane is a private, nonprofit organization governed by a dedicated volunteer Board of Directors that work on behalf of Berkeley Humane and the animals in our community.

feeds.title: Dakin Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: Dakin Humane Society is a Community-supported animal welfare organization that provides shelter, medical care, spay/neuter services, and behavioral rehabilitation for more than 20,000 animals and people each year. Find stories about our rescues, events and more!

feeds.title: Humane Society of Utah Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with our animal shelter and adoptions. The Humane Society of Utah is dedicated to the elimination of pain, fear, and suffering in all animals. Our goal is to keep pets and people together, bring them together, and help move each animal to its most appropriate outcome as quickly as possible.

feeds.title: Humane Society of Harrisburg Area Blog
feeds.description: Learn about the latest happenings at HSHA as well as helpful tips from our experts to keep your pets healthy and happy! The Humane Society of Harrisburg Area assists over 10,000 animals a year through our residential care and adoption program, low-cost veterinary clinics, pet food bank, and counseling services. The mission of the Humane Society of Harrisburg Area, Inc. is to build a better community for pets and people through compassion, protection, education, and collaboration.

feeds.title: HSPPR Blog
feeds.description: From tips for caring for your pet to learning more about animal welfare, our blog has it all! HSPPR offers compassionate care to animals, supports safe communities, and provides socially conscious sheltering.

feeds.title: Liberty Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: Liberty Humane Society's mission is to foster a community of compassion and respect and provide animals in need with a chance at a lifelong, loving home. Find more about our shelter, animal control, fostering and more!

feeds.title: Maui Humane Society
feeds.description: Our blog showcases humane efforts by the MHS Team to help surrendered cats and dogs find a better shelter in Maui. The Maui Humane Society is a non-profit organization, with a mission to protect and save the lives of Maui's animals, accepting all in need, educating the community, and inspiring respect and compassion towards all animals.

feeds.title: Lowell Humane Society News
feeds.description: The purpose of the Lowell Humane Society shall be to provide shelter, prevent cruelty to animals, and advocate for their welfare. Through humane education, Society strives to enlighten the public with the goal of improving the quality of life for animals and people.

feeds.title: Heritage Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: The Heritage Humane Society serves as the compassionate steward of companion animals that are in transition from stray/surrender to forever homes. Heritage Humane Society blog will educate the public about humane animal care and treatment and advocate animal welfare.

feeds.title: HARP Blog
feeds.description: Whether you're welcoming a new pet into your home or looking for guidance about the pets you currently have, we have several resources to help you! Explore our links to some of the common issues you may be facing with your pet.

feeds.title: Palo Alto Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: PAHS is one of the few humane societies nationwide with no animal shelter. Instead of managing animals inside a shelter, we work to keep animals out of the shelter through humane programs in intervention, advocacy, and education. Get the latest news from PAHS, tips and advice for fostered and adopted animals, animal welfare and more!

feeds.title: Roice-Hurst Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: Roice-Hurst is an animal shelter and adoption center that provides loving care for homeless dogs and cats and services to our community aimed at keeping pets in their loving homes. We never euthanize animals because of a lack of space or resources. If you would like more information about our shelter, check out our blog.

feeds.title: Humane Society for Greater Nashua Blog
feeds.description: The Humane Society for Greater Nashua advocates for and enhances the lives of animals entrusted to our care while educating our community to strengthen the human-animal bond. Stay up to date on news, events, and shelter happenings!

feeds.title: Humane Society of Southern Arizona Blog
feeds.description: The Humane Society of Southern Arizona has saved over 1 million pets since 1944. We take in pets from all over Southern Arizona, assisting smaller shelters by taking in hard-to-place pets and pets with serious medical needs - pets who might not otherwise have a chance at life. adoptable pet videos, educational classes, fun events, HSSA Thrift Store sales and more!

feeds.title: Humane Society of Broward County Blog
feeds.description: Advocating for and improving the lives of animals by providing adoptions, community services and education. Get all the latest cuteness, cause-furthering info and community highlights. A passion for pets and their people The Humane Society of Broward County is about many things, but when you get down to it, we just want to bring amazing animals and people together.

feeds.title: Seattle Humane Blog
feeds.description: Get the Seattle Humane news, inspiring stories, upcoming events and ways to support our lifesaving work. Founded in 1897, Seattle Humane proudly promotes the human-animal bond by saving and serving pets in need. We are one of the region's leaders in animal adoption, education and welfare.

feeds.title: Pasadena Humane Blog
feeds.description: Check out Pasadena Humane's blog to stay in the know, learn useful tips and more. Pasadena Humane is more than an animal shelter; we are a community-supported animal resource center providing compassion and care for all animals.

feeds.title: Humane World for Animals
feeds.description: News and analysis of animal protection issues from Kitty Block, president, and CEO of the Humane Society of the United States. Kitty Block is President and CEO of the HSUS. Block, an attorney, has devoted more than a quarter century to protecting animals. She joined the HSUS in 1992 as a legal investigator and was instrumental in bringing cruelties such as horse slaughter and the killing of dogs and cats for their fur in China to light.

feeds.title: Ottawa Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: The Ottawa Humane Society is a non-profit, community-based organization and a registered charity. We have a volunteer board of directors, drawn from our supporters and the community at large. Since 1888, we have been the leading organization providing a safe haven for sick, injured, and homeless animals in Ottawa.

feeds.title: NOCO Humane Blog
feeds.description: Larimer Humane Society is an independent nonprofit working to further the compassionate, safe, and responsible relationship between animals and people. Find out what's going on at Larimer Humane Society with our blog.

feeds.title: Brevard Humane Society Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1952, the Brevard Humane Society (Central Brevard Humane Society) is the County's oldest established animal welfare organization. A 'no kill for space' shelter, the Humane Society is dedicated to speaking for those who cannot speak for themselves. The Humane Society educates the community on responsible pet ownership and the humane treatment of animals, advocates for spaying/neutering to reduce the homeless pet population.

feeds.title: Humane Society of Pinellas Blog
feeds.description: Our shelter news page is here to provide you with HSP happenings and information you may need to care for your pet, get a better understanding about our community's pet population, and more. The Humane Society of Pinellas is a non-profit organization that has been caring for animals and our community since 1949. The Humane Society of Pinellas is dedicated to providing individualized care for every animal that comes our way and we ensure that every treatable animal is treated.

feeds.title: Humane Society of Southern Illinois Blog
feeds.description: Check out what is going on at the Humane Society of Southern Illinois. Find our latest announcements, events, and community interests. The Humane Society of Southern Illinois was founded in 1956. We are a very small non-profit 0pen access facility that accepts any animal that is brought to us by the public as well as functioning as the holding facility for all of Jackson County Animal Controls.
